items.title: Woody Marks: Not spotted at Thursday's practice
items.text:
Marks (knee) wasn't spotted during the portion of Thursday's practice session open to reporters, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

items.title: David Montgomery: At practice Thursday
items.text:
Montgomery (groin) was present for practice Thursday, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Spotted without helmet at start of practice Thursday
items.text:
Tuten (ankle) was the Jaguars' only player without a helmet during the initial portion of Thursday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Set for surgery on finger Friday
items.text:
Jacobs (finger) will undergo surgery Friday, and the Packers will have a better sense of his recovery timetable afterward, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Denzel Boston: Says toe feels better
items.text:
Boston (toe) said Thursday that he's hoping to return to practice and "definitely feel(s) better" after sitting out Wednesday's practice, Zac Jackson of The Athletic reports.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Participating in Thursday's practice
items.text:
Brown (knee/ankle) is taking part in Thursday's practice, which Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site describes as a jog-through.
